---
title: "Agriculture Analysis"
format: html
editor: visual
---

## Load in Packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(here)
library(mapview)
```

## Read in Data from 2015 & 2020

```{r}
ag_2015 <- st_read(here("data/ag_land_2015.geojson"))
```

```{r}
ag_2020 <- st_read(here("data/ag_land_2020.geojson"))
```

## Make a map

```{r}
mapview(ag_2015, zcol = "cropcatego")
```

R color brewer can enhance this

set n = 15

#### Distribution of Acreage

```{r}
ggplot(ag_2015, aes(x = acreage)) + 
  geom_histogram() + 
  theme_bw()
```

What has that land been converted to?\
